title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11713__PART_2_)
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard ( Part 2 ) provides guidelines for safty measures in computer installations from hazards, such as fire, flood, earthquakes, magnetic fields, pests and rodents. Note — For the purpose of this standard, * Safety ' means provision of protection against damage or loss to personnel and equipment.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Code of practice for general design details and preparatory work for damp-proofing and water-proofing of buildings
Code of practice for the protection of buildings and allied structures against lightning
Code of practice for handling of electrostatic sensitive devices

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
